rationale: The gating structure is internally coherent, but the signal leg is Sloan's working-capital accrual (a canonical anomaly, whose distress-conditioning is itself documented) subjected to a second difference on an already-differenced quantity, producing a triple-differenced, high-noise measure whose coverage will be crippled by the sparse `txp` input (~0.125 in the archive).

This is largely a re-parameterization of the archive's InventoryFundingGapDistressSpread — same inventory-minus-payables accrual leg and same `dltt` distress component — with two confounded changes (dropping the MA(3) smoothing that may have driven the -3.1 alpha, and swapping profitability for sales growth) and no diagnosis of why that signal's Fama-MacBeth and portfolio evidence disagreed.

Subtracting `oancf/at` from `apalch/at` yields a quantity dominated in magnitude and variance by negative operating cash flow, so the expression is essentially a (sign-consistent) restatement of the cash-based operating profitability anomaly rather than the "payables-propped cash flow" construct the hypothesis describes.

The signal leg (txp − txt)/at is mechanically increasing when tax expense is low, which is precisely the low-profitability condition already imposed by the `NEG(pi/at)` state leg, so the interaction is largely redundant rather than conditional — and the closely related TaxPayableOverhangUnderDebt already failed with a wrong-signed FMB t-stat.

The stated rationale is factually wrong — `oancf` already adds depreciation back, so ADD(oancf, dp) double-counts it rather than "distinguishing noncash charges" — and stripped of that error the signal is cash-flow-to-assets profitability gated on distress, a well-known combination.

The change in the magnitude of other operating accruals is a genuinely distinct opacity-deterioration construct (not a level restatement of the failed OpaqueAccrualFragility) with a coherent gate and correct sign, though the differenced absolute value will be noisy and coverage was already only ~0.09 for the level version.
